Boots a lightweight Alpine Linux guest in QEMU. Without hardware virtualization this is pure software emulation, so it measures how fast a full guest system can run on this phone. The guest images (about 30 MB) are downloaded on first use.
The Shield blocks trackers and ads by refusing their domain lookups (DNS). It runs entirely on this phone as a local VPN: your traffic is not sent to SpirOS or any proxy.
Runs as the always-on VPN of the space, covering every app inside it. No system prompt is needed.
Disable Google services in the space
Hides Google Play Services and the Play Store inside the space. Some apps need them for notifications or sign-in.
Android will ask you once to allow the VPN. Only one VPN can be active at a time.
Settings apply to the space the next time you turn its Shield on.
Limits: apps that use their own encrypted DNS, and a Private DNS host set in system settings, bypass the Shield.
History, cookies and site data erased
The SpirOS icon becomes a working calculator. Type your PIN and press = to open it. The icon may take a moment to change.
Your isolated space is not set up yet. Create it to see its apps here.
The space has no apps yet. Tap here to add some.

Android allows only one work profile, and only the app that created it (or you, in system Settings) can delete or manage it. SpirOS cannot take it over, but it can show what it is, open its apps, and take you to where it is removed. Once it is gone, come back here and the Create button will appear.
Created by an earlier SpirOS install. Its pairing key was lost when SpirOS was reinstalled, so it must be removed and created again.
Its managing app could not be identified (it may be a company or system profile).
To remove it: Settings › Accounts (or Passwords & accounts) › Work › Remove work profile. On some phones: Settings › Users & accounts › Work profile.
To remove it: Settings › Apps › App twin (or Dual apps / Clone apps) and turn the clones off.
To remove it: Settings › Security & privacy › Private space › Delete private space.

A full Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS in Linux Mint style, or your own system), running directly on your phone\'s processor (no emulation), inside the SpirOS Engine\'s private storage. Use it like a computer: files, terminal, Python, AI models and later MT5 for desktop.
This phone\'s processor or this build does not support the Linux desktop.
Pick a system below. SpirOS downloads it in the background, checks its fingerprint (SHA-256) and installs it privately.

Tap = click · Long press = right click · Drag = move/select · ⇞ ⇟ = scroll · Type in the bar at the top. For a full keyboard inside Linux: Applications › Accessibility › Onboard. Turn the phone sideways for a wider desktop.
The Linux system and every file inside it will be deleted.

Android 12+ may close Linux programs when there are many running in the background. If the desktop stops by itself, open Settings › Developer options and turn on \"Disable child process restrictions\".
An AI model that runs entirely on your phone, inside the Linux system. Nothing you type leaves the phone, and it works without internet once the model is downloaded.
Your phone has about %1$d GB of RAM. Recommended model: %2$s
The AI server stopped. Its last messages:
The private AI runs inside the Linux system (SpirOS Engine). Open Linux to install the engine and the Linux system first.
When off, SpirOS opens without a PIN. Your files stay encrypted on this phone.

Anyone holding your unlocked phone will be able to open SpirOS, the vault and the space. The files remain encrypted with this phone\'s hardware key, so a copy is still unreadable elsewhere. You can turn the PIN back on at any time.
Also allows screen recording and the preview in recent apps.
Users, passwords and administrators, without the terminal
Install the Linux system first (Linux screen).
Manage the Linux system\'s accounts here. The selected account (●) is the one the desktop runs as; restart the desktop after changing it.
● = the account the desktop runs as.
The account and its home folder will be deleted.
Make SpirOS lighter and faster on this phone
Options that reduce memory, CPU and battery use. Defaults are already tuned for mid-range phones.
Google Play services take 300–500 MB of memory in the space and run all the time. Biggest saving.
Stops every app in the space until you resume it.
No transparency or shadows, outline-only window moves, no power manager or screensaver.
Linux, the AI and the Lab use no CPU while SpirOS is closed, and continue instantly when you return. Turn off to keep MT5 or long jobs running.
Starts only this program with a window manager, without the desktop and panel. Much lighter.
Changes apply the next time the desktop starts.
Uses the %1$d fast cores out of %2$d. The slow cores make the AI wait.
Smaller = less RAM and faster start; larger = remembers longer conversations.
While SpirOS is open, putting the phone screen-down on a table for a second triggers Panic.
Pressing Home while the Linux desktop is open keeps it live in a small corner window.
Type it on the calculator and press = to reveal SpirOS.
Use digits and the calculator signs + − × ÷ . (at least 4). Only a fingerprint of the code is stored.

Linux and the private AI run in a small helper app with no icon and no access to your vault, space or keys. Android only lets apps built for Android 9 run Linux programs (like Termux), so only this helper is built that way; SpirOS itself keeps every modern Android protection. SpirOS downloads it from its own release, checks its checksum and that it is signed with the same key as SpirOS, then Android asks you to confirm.
A newer SpirOS Engine is available for this version of SpirOS.
The first time, Android asks you to allow SpirOS to install apps; turn it on, come back and press the button again.
Runs in the background: you can leave this screen or SpirOS; the notification shows the progress.
Stopped. The downloaded part is kept, so you can continue later.
Ubuntu 24.04 with Xfce in Linux Mint style (Mint-Y theme, Whisker menu, one bottom panel). Fast and light.
Ubuntu 24.04 with MATE, the classic desktop of Linux Mint MATE edition. A little heavier than Xfce.
Linux Mint\'s flagship desktop, closest to the real Mint look.
Any Linux root filesystem (.tar.xz, .tar.gz or .tar) for this phone\'s CPU, from an https link or a file. Debian/Ubuntu-based systems get a desktop installed automatically on first start.
Download ≈ %1$s GB · for phones with %2$d GB RAM or more
Your phone has %1$d GB RAM: this desktop may be slow or close itself.
Heavy: Cinnamon needs OpenGL, which is drawn by the CPU here. Expect a slower desktop, more heat and battery use.
Only install systems you trust. With a SHA-256 the file is checked before installing. It must be built for this phone\'s CPU (usually arm64 / aarch64).
Changing the system deletes the current Linux system and its files. Downloaded AI models are kept.
Touchpad · 1 finger: move, tap: click · 2 fingers: scroll, tap: right click

SpirOS inside the space has not opened its command channel yet (it repairs itself after a SpirOS update, a phone restart or resuming the space). Restart the phone and try again, or approve the direct connection on the space screen.
Another app is listening for SpirOS\'s space commands, so SpirOS did not send its key. Uninstall unknown apps that might do this.
The space did not accept the command (its pairing key does not match, often after reinstalling SpirOS). Delete the space from system settings and create it again.
You can always delete the space yourself: system Settings → Accounts (or Passwords & accounts / Users & accounts) → Work → Remove work profile.
Creating the isolated space…\nThe phone finishes setting it up in a few seconds.

Your vault and the apps on your main profile are not affected.
Android\'s \"connected apps\" lets SpirOS reach its copy inside the space directly, on every phone brand. Approve it once on the next screen; only SpirOS itself is allowed.
Showing on %1$s · this screen is the touchpad
When a TV or monitor is connected by cable (HDMI / USB-C) or as a wireless display, the Linux desktop appears on it and the phone becomes the touchpad and keyboard.
Start the desktop at the external screen\'s size (up to 1920 wide).

Your phone did not let SpirOS finish setting up inside the space, so commands cannot reach it. Repair opens SpirOS inside the space for a second to complete it; then approve the connection that appears here.
SpirOS could not be started inside the space. Delete the space from system settings (Accounts → Work → Remove) and create it again with this version.

Our own light system made for the phone: every app full screen, a big bottom bar, an app grid with large icons, and the essentials (files, terminal, editor, images, PDF, archives, Python, AI). MetaTrader 5 opens from the app grid.
